vatNumbers.title: EU VAT numbers
vatNumbers.description: Required unless datasetId is set. Array of strings with the country prefix, e.g. ["IE6388047V","DE 811 128 135","IT00743110157"]. Spaces, dots and dashes are fine; GR becomes EL. Add " | Expected name" to compare names, e.g. "IE6388047V | Google Ireland". One row per unique number.

defaultCountry.title: Default country
defaultCountry.description: Optional 2-letter EU code (e.g. "DE") used for numbers that have no country prefix.

requesterVatNumber.title: Your EU VAT number (for consultation numbers)
requesterVatNumber.description: Optional. Your own EU VAT number, e.g. "DE123456789". VIES then returns a consultation number per valid check, which tax authorities accept as proof that you checked. It is sent only to VIES and is not stored in the output.

maxNumbers.title: Max numbers
maxNumbers.description: Check at most this many unique numbers per run (default 5000). Aliases: maxItems, limit, maxResults.

datasetId.title: Or: dataset ID from another Actor
datasetId.description: Optional. Read VAT numbers from another run's dataset, e.g. a supplier or customer export. Example: "aBcD1234efGH5678". In an integration the triggering run's dataset is used automatically.

vatField.title: VAT field in that dataset
vatField.description: Field holding the VAT number (dot paths work). Leave empty to auto-detect: vatNumber, vat, vatId, vat_number, taxId, euVat.

nameField.title: Company name field in that dataset
nameField.description: Optional field to compare with the VIES name (nameMatch). Leave empty to auto-detect: companyName, name, company, legalName.

datasetMaxItems.title: Max values from the dataset
datasetMaxItems.description: Read at most this many values from the dataset (default 1000).

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Numbers checked in parallel (1-10, default 4). VIES limits concurrent requests; higher values cause more retries.

perCountryConcurrency.title: Per-country concurrency
perCountryConcurrency.description: Parallel requests per member state (1-5, default 2). Some national services (e.g. DE, IT, ES) reject bursts.

maxRetries.title: Retries when a country is busy
maxRetries.description: Retries with backoff on MS_UNAVAILABLE, MS_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ or timeouts (0-6, default 3). After that the row is service_unavailable (free).
